hints.title: Row Column Index Symmetry
hints.text: A sequence of words forms a valid word square if the character at row r and column c matches the character at row c and column r for all valid positions.

hints.title: Ragged Array Bounds Guard
hints.text: Because words may have different lengths, ensure that accessing column c in row r implies column index c is within row bounds and row index r is within column bounds.

hints.title: Direct Grid Comparison
hints.text: Iterate r from 0 to len(words) - 1. For each character c in words[r], verify that c < len(words), r < len(words[c]), and words[r][c] == words[c][r].

complexity.notes: Optimal linear scan verifying symmetry in O(N * M) time with zero extra space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Padding ragged matrices with placeholder spaces creates unnecessary string copies.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place character lookup avoids copying strings or allocating transposes.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle irregular word lengths where rows have varying sizes.
